candidates.reason: The text stack is well rebuilt for the skyscraper: the headline wraps cleanly, the body copy is readable, the CTA has proper margins and the hierarchy is right. But the SOLSTICE logo is tiny and pushed into the top-right corner, off the centred axis everything else uses. The can is small and leaves dead space above and below it.

Same structure as candidate 1, with a bigger, bolder headline. The CTA pill nearly touches both canvas edges, so the side margins are cramped. The logo is again a tiny mark stuck off-axis in the top-right. The body copy is a dense four-line block, and the can floats with a large empty band above it.

Close to candidate 2, but the sun icon on the can's lid is clipped behind the can top, which damages a brand mark. The logo is tiny and off-axis in the top-right. The CTA is cramped against the edges, and the can sits in a void with uneven gaps.

This is the square design shrunk into the middle of the tall canvas, not rearranged. The body copy and CTA label are unreadably small, and the logo is nearly invisible. About two-thirds of the canvas is empty background, so it fails the fit-to-format requirement.
